title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
statement: Both lists are sorted ascending. Splice their nodes together into one sorted list and return its head. Reuse the existing nodes rather than allocating new ones.
hints: A dummy head node saves you from special-casing the very first append.
Repeatedly take the smaller of the two front nodes and append it, advancing that list.
When one list runs out the other is already sorted, so append it wholesale rather than looping.
